description: Read-only MCP server for WordPress plugin audits: vulnerabilities, bloat, cron, orphaned tables.
name: io.github.mwstech/auditra

site_domain.description: The domain of the WordPress site running the Auditra plugin, without a scheme or trailing slash (for example: example.com). The site must be reachable over HTTPS.

token.description: The access token generated in the site's wp-admin under Tools → Auditra. Treat it like a password: anyone holding this URL can read the site's plugin inventory. It can be revoked and regenerated from the same screen at any time.

title: Auditra
